description: You find a hidden shrine. Permanently gain +5 max health.
A traveling merchant teaches you a new technique. +3 attack permanently.
You rest by a campfire and feel refreshed. +2 defense permanently.
Studying ancient runes increases your magical power. +3 magic permanently.
You discover a mana crystal. +10 max mana permanently.
You stumble through cursed ground. -5 max health permanently.
A mysterious potion restores your vitality. +8 max health.
An old knight shares his wisdom. +4 attack permanently.
You meditate in a clearing. +5 magic permanently.
